why: The include block (user, serviceType, embassy, payments) is duplicated 4 times across findById (line 95), findAll (line 132), updateStatus (line 170), and the second query in create (line 81). The first query in create (line 60) omits payments, then a second query repeats the include with payments. This creates drift risk: if the include shape changes, it must be updated in 4+ places.
finding: Duplicate Prisma include block repeated 4 times; first create query omits payments then re-queries with payments
suggestion: Extract the include object to a private static constant or helper method (e.g., private static SERVICE_REQUEST_INCLUDE = { user: {...}, serviceType: {...}, embassy: {...}, payments: true }) and reuse it in all queries. Consider including payments in the first create query to avoid the round-trip.

why: CreateProfileDto.validate (lines 16-82, ~67 lines) and UpdateProfileDto.validate (lines 108-176, ~69 lines) are nearly identical. The only difference: Create requires gender (lines 19-23), Update makes it optional (lines 111-117). All 7 other field validations (dateOfBirth, avatar, bio, city, state, country, postalCode) are duplicated verbatim. This pattern repeats in embassy.dto.ts and user.dto.ts, creating systemic drift risk: a validation rule change (e.g., bio max length) must be updated in 2+ places per DTO pair.
finding: CreateProfileDto and UpdateProfileDto duplicate ~130 lines of validation logic; only gender requiredness differs
suggestion: Extract shared validation logic to a private static method or base class (e.g., ProfileDtoBase.validateField(field, value, rules)). Each DTO calls the shared method with field-specific rules, only differing on required/optional flags. This pattern should be applied consistently across all Create/Update DTO pairs in the codebase (profile, embassy, user, service-type, etc.).

why: CreateProfileDto.sanitize (lines 84-95) and UpdateProfileDto.sanitize (lines 178-189) are identical except for the class instantiated. Both trim the same 7 optional fields. This duplication mirrors the validate() duplication and creates the same drift risk.
finding: CreateProfileDto and UpdateProfileDto sanitize methods are identical except for target class
suggestion: Extract to a shared static sanitize method that accepts the target DTO class or use a base class with a protected static sanitizeFields method that both children call.
